    mvcc.RangesOk W L) : L.length ≤ W.size

    mvcc.WatchRange) (hw : W !! wa = some r) (he : r.end? = none) (hL : mvcc.RangesOk W L) :
    mvcc.RangesOk (GMap.delete wa W) L

  iprop(∃ m,
      ⌜z.snd = interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watcherSet.ty (intoVal m)⌝ ∗
        mvcc.ownWatcherSet m (mvcc.ivlMembers W z.fst) q)

  iprop(typedPointsto

              (DFrac.own q))

theorem mvcc.rangesOk_find_unique (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (L : List adt.Entry) (hL :
    mvcc.RangesOk W L) (z : adt.Entry) (ivl : adt.IvlS) (hz : z ∈ L) (hz1 : z.fst = ivl) :
    List.find? (fun y => decide (y.fst = ivl)) L = some z

theorem mvcc.keyMembers_delete (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (wa : Loc) (k : GoString) :
    mvcc.keyMembers (GMap.delete wa W) k = GMap.delete wa (mvcc.keyMembers W k)

theorem mvcc.covers_some (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (k e : GoString) (h : r.end? = some e) : r.covers k =
    true ↔ adt.ivlCmp (k, k ++ [0#8]) (r.key, e) = 0

def mvcc.RangesOk (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (L : List adt.Entry) : Prop :=
  List.Pairwise (fun a b => adt.ivlLt a.fst b.fst) L ∧
    ∀ (ivl : adt.IvlS), ivl ∈ List.map Prod.fst L ↔ ∃ w r e, W !! w = some r ∧ r.end? = some e ∧ ivl = (r.key, e)

theorem mvcc.membersBy_delete (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (p : mvcc.WatchRange → Bool) (w : Loc)
    : mvcc.membersBy (GMap.delete w W) p = GMap.delete w (mvcc.membersBy W p)

def mvcc.keyMembers (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (k : GoString) : GMap Loc Unit :=
  mvcc.membersBy W fun r => decide (r.end? = none) && decide (r.key = k)

theorem mvcc.ivlMembers_insert_ne (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (wa : Loc) (r : mvcc.WatchRange)
    (ivl : adt.IvlS) (hw : W !! wa = none) (h : Option.map (fun e => (r.key, e)) r.end? ≠ some ivl)
    : mvcc.ivlMembers (<[wa := r]>W) ivl = mvcc.ivlMembers W ivl

theorem mvcc.covers_none (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (k : GoString) (h : r.end? = none) : r.covers k =
    true ↔ k = r.key

theorem mvcc.find?_fst_unique {α : Type} (L : List (adt.IvlS × α)) (hnd : (List.map Prod.fst
    L).Nodup) (ivl : adt.IvlS) (z : adt.IvlS × α) (hz : z ∈ L) (hz1 : z.fst = ivl) : List.find? (fun
    y => decide (y.fst = ivl)) L = some z

theorem mvcc.keyMembers_insert_ne (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (wa : Loc) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (k
    : GoString) (hw : W !! wa = none) (h : ¬(r.end? = none ∧ r.key = k)) : mvcc.keyMembers (<[wa :=
    r]>W) k = mvcc.keyMembers W k

theorem mvcc.coverUpTo_disjoint (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (key : GoString) (ivls : List
    adt.IvlS) (ivl : adt.IvlS) (h : ¬ivl ∈ ivls) : (mvcc.coverUpTo W key ivls).Disjoint
    (mvcc.ivlMembers W ivl)

def mvcc.ivlMembers (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (ivl : adt.IvlS) : GMap Loc Unit :=
  mvcc.membersBy W fun r => decide (Option.map (fun e => (r.key, e)) r.end? = some ivl)

theorem mvcc.keyMembers_empty_iff (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (k : GoString) : mvcc.keyMembers W
    k = ∅ ↔ ¬∃ w r, W !! w = some r ∧ r.end? = none ∧ r.key = k

theorem mvcc.rangeSets_congr (W W' : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (L : List adt.Entry) (h : ∀ (z :
    adt.Entry), z ∈ L → mvcc.ivlMembers W' z.fst = mvcc.ivlMembers W z.fst) : ([∗list] z ∈ L,
    mvcc.rangeSet W z) ⊢ [∗list] z ∈ L, mvcc.rangeSet W' z

def mvcc.WatchRange.ivl (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (e : GoString) : adt.IvlS :=
  (r.key, e)

theorem mvcc.keyMembers_insert_eq (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (wa : Loc) (r : mvcc.WatchRange)
    (hw : W !! wa = none) (h : r.end? = none) : mvcc.keyMembers (<[wa := r]>W) r.key = <[wa :=
    ()]>(mvcc.keyMembers W r.key)

theorem mvcc.ivlMembers_delete (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (wa : Loc) (ivl : adt.IvlS) :
    mvcc.ivlMembers (GMap.delete wa W) ivl = GMap.delete wa (mvcc.ivlMembers W ivl)

    L).Nodup) (ivl : adt.IvlS) (i : Nat) (z : adt.IvlS × α) (hz : L[i]? = some z) (hz1 : z.fst =

theorem mvcc.sorted_nodup {α : Type} (L : List (adt.IvlS × α)) (hs : List.Pairwise (fun a b =>
    adt.ivlLt a.fst b.fst) L) : (List.map Prod.fst L).Nodup

theorem mvcc.membersBy_or (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (p q : mvcc.WatchRange → Bool) :
    (mvcc.membersBy W fun r => p r || q r) = mvcc.membersBy W p ∪ mvcc.membersBy W q

theorem mvcc.covers_from (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (k : GoString) (h : r.end? = some []) (hk : r.key ≠
    []) : r.covers k = !decide (go.GoStringLt k r.key)

def mvcc.ownWatcherGroup (wg : Loc) (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (q : Qp := 1) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ km ws t KM L,
      "Hwg" ∷
          typedPointsto wg
            { keyWatchers' := km,
              ranges' := interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.pkg.v3.adt.intervalTree.ty.PointerType (intoVal t),
              watchers' := ws }
            (DFrac.own q) ∗
        "Hws" ∷ mvcc.ownWatcherSet ws W.domSet q ∗
          ("#Hfixed" ∷ [∗map] w ↦ r ∈ W, iprop(∃ fcs, mvcc.watcherFixed w r fcs)) ∗
            "Hkm" ∷ mvcc.ownKeyMap km KM W q ∗
              "Hivt" ∷ adt.ownIvt t L q ∗ "%HL" ∷ ⌜mvcc.RangesOk W L⌝ ∗ "Hranges" ∷ [∗list] z ∈ L, mvcc.rangeSet W z q)

theorem mvcc.succ_ne_empty (k : GoString) : k ++ [0#8] ≠ []

theorem mvcc.ownWatcherGroup_at (wg : Loc) (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (q : Qp) :
    mvcc.ownWatcherGroup wg W q ⊣⊢ ∃ ws, mvcc.ownWatcherGroupAt wg W ws q

theorem mvcc.stab_point_ne_nil_iff (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (L : List adt.Entry) (hL : ∀ (ivl
    : adt.IvlS), ivl ∈ List.map Prod.fst L ↔ ∃ w r e, W !! w = some r ∧ r.end? = some e ∧ ivl =
    (r.key, e)) (k : GoString) : adt.stab (k, k ++ [0#8]) L ≠ [] ↔ ∃ w r e, W !! w = some r ∧ r.end?
    = some e ∧ r.covers k = true

theorem mvcc.watcherFixed_persistent (w : Loc) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (fcs : GoSlice) : Persistent
    (mvcc.watcherFixed w r fcs)

theorem mvcc.ownWatcherGroup_fixed (wg : Loc) (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) : mvcc.ownWatcherGroup
    wg W ⊢ mvcc.ownWatcherGroup wg W ∗ [∗map] w ↦ r ∈ W, iprop(∃ fcs, mvcc.watcherFixed w r fcs)

theorem mvcc.ownWatcherGroup_intro (wg : Loc) (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (km ws t : Loc) (KM :
    GMap GoString GoMap) (L : List adt.Entry) (hL : mvcc.RangesOk W L) : (typedPointsto wg {
    keyWatchers' := km, ranges' := interface.mkOk
    go_etcd_io.etcd.pkg.v3.adt.intervalTree.ty.PointerType (intoVal t), watchers' := ws } (DFrac.own
    1) ∗ mvcc.ownWatcherSet ws W.domSet ∗ ([∗map] w ↦ r ∈ W, iprop(∃ fcs, mvcc.watcherFixed w r
    fcs)) ∗ mvcc.ownKeyMap km KM W ∗ adt.ownIvt t L 1 ∗ [∗list] z ∈ L, mvcc.rangeSet W z) ⊢
    mvcc.ownWatcherGroup wg W

theorem mvcc.perm_eraseP_of_find? {α : Type} (L : List α) (p : α → Bool) (z : α) (h : List.find? p L
    = some z) : L.Perm (z :: List.eraseP p L)

theorem mvcc.coverUpTo_stab (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (L : List adt.Entry) (hL : mvcc.RangesOk
    W L) (key : GoString) : mvcc.coverUpTo W key (List.map Prod.fst (adt.stab (key, key ++ [0#8])
    L)) = mvcc.membersBy W fun x => x.covers key

theorem mvcc.ivlMembers_empty_iff (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (ivl : adt.IvlS) : mvcc.ivlMembers
    W ivl = ∅ ↔ ¬∃ w r e, W !! w = some r ∧ r.end? = some e ∧ ivl = (r.key, e)

theorem mvcc.rangesOk_insert_range (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (L L' : List adt.Entry) (wa : Loc)
    (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (e : GoString) (hw : W !! wa = none) (he : r.end? = some e) (hL : ∀ (ivl :
    adt.IvlS), ivl ∈ List.map Prod.fst L ↔ ∃ w r e, W !! w = some r ∧ r.end? = some e ∧ ivl =
    (r.key, e)) (hs : List.Pairwise (fun a b => adt.ivlLt a.fst b.fst) L') (hL' : ∀ (ivl :
    adt.IvlS), ivl ∈ List.map Prod.fst L' ↔ ivl ∈ List.map Prod.fst L ∨ ivl = (r.key, e)) :
    mvcc.RangesOk (<[wa := r]>W) L'

theorem mvcc.ivlCmp_point_iff (k b e : GoString) : adt.ivlCmp (k, k ++ [0#8]) (b, e) = 0 ↔
    adt.affCmp k b ≥ 0 ∧ adt.affCmp k e < 0

theorem mvcc.watcherFixed_agree (w : Loc) (r r' : mvcc.WatchRange) (fcs fcs' : GoSlice) :
    mvcc.watcherFixed w r fcs ∗ mvcc.watcherFixed w r' fcs' ⊢ ⌜r = r' ∧ fcs = fcs'⌝

theorem mvcc.membersBy_empty_iff (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (p : mvcc.WatchRange → Bool) :
    mvcc.membersBy W p = ∅ ↔ ¬∃ w r, W !! w = some r ∧ p r = true

structure mvcc.WatchRange : Type where
  key : GoString
  end? : Option GoString
  startRev : w64
  id : w64

def mvcc.ownWatcherSet (m : GoMap) (S : GMap Loc Unit) (q : Qp := 1) : IProp GF :=
  ownMap m (DFrac.own q) S

theorem mvcc.membersBy_lookup (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (p : mvcc.WatchRange → Bool) (w : Loc)
    : mvcc.membersBy W p !! w = match W !! w with | some r => if p r = true then some () else none |
    none => none

theorem mvcc.exists_ivl_delete (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (wa : Loc) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (hw :
    W !! wa = some r) (ivl : adt.IvlS) (hne : Option.map (fun e => (r.key, e)) r.end? ≠ some ivl) :
    (∃ w r' e, GMap.delete wa W !! w = some r' ∧ r'.end? = some e ∧ ivl = (r'.key, e)) ↔ ∃ w r' e, W
    !! w = some r' ∧ r'.end? = some e ∧ ivl = (r'.key, e)

theorem mvcc.membersBy_insert (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (p : mvcc.WatchRange → Bool) (w : Loc)
    (r : mvcc.WatchRange) : mvcc.membersBy (<[w := r]>W) p = if p r = true then <[w :=
    ()]>(mvcc.membersBy W p) else GMap.delete w (mvcc.membersBy W p)

def mvcc.membersBy (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (p : mvcc.WatchRange → Bool) : GMap Loc Unit :=
  GMap.fmap (fun x => ()) (GMap.filter (fun x r => p r) W)

def mvcc.WatchRange.covers (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (k : GoString) : Bool :=
  match r.end? with
  | none => decide (k = r.key)
  | some e => decide (adt.affCmp k r.key ≥ 0 ∧ adt.affCmp k e < 0)

theorem mvcc.ivlMembers_insert_eq (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (wa : Loc) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (e
    : GoString) (hw : W !! wa = none) (h : r.end? = some e) : mvcc.ivlMembers <[wa := r]>W (r.key,
    e) = <[wa := ()]>(mvcc.ivlMembers W (r.key, e))

theorem mvcc.mem_eraseP_fst {α : Type} (L : List (adt.IvlS × α)) (hnd : (List.map Prod.fst L).Nodup)
    (ivl : adt.IvlS) (z : adt.IvlS × α) : z ∈ List.eraseP (fun z => decide (z.fst = ivl)) L ↔ z ∈ L
    ∧ z.fst ≠ ivl

def mvcc.ownWatcherGroupAt (wg : Loc) (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (ws : GoMap) (q : Qp := 1) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ km t KM L,
      "Hwg" ∷
          typedPointsto wg
            { keyWatchers' := km,
              ranges' := interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.pkg.v3.adt.intervalTree.ty.PointerType (intoVal t),
              watchers' := ws }
            (DFrac.own q) ∗
        "Hws" ∷ mvcc.ownWatcherSet ws W.domSet q ∗
          ("#Hfixed" ∷ [∗map] w ↦ r ∈ W, iprop(∃ fcs, mvcc.watcherFixed w r fcs)) ∗
            "Hkm" ∷ mvcc.ownKeyMap km KM W q ∗
              "Hivt" ∷ adt.ownIvt t L q ∗ "%HL" ∷ ⌜mvcc.RangesOk W L⌝ ∗ "Hranges" ∷ [∗list] z ∈ L, mvcc.rangeSet W z q)

theorem mvcc.upTo_all (keys : List Loc) (S' : GMap Loc Unit) (h : ∀ (k : Loc), k ∈ keys ↔ (S' !!
    k).isSome = true) : mvcc.upTo keys keys.length S' = S'

theorem mvcc.ivlMembers_delete_ne (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (wa : Loc) (r : mvcc.WatchRange)
    (hw : W !! wa = some r) (ivl : adt.IvlS) (hne : Option.map (fun e => (r.key, e)) r.end? ≠ some
    ivl) : mvcc.ivlMembers (GMap.delete wa W) ivl = mvcc.ivlMembers W ivl

theorem mvcc.ownWatcherGroup_member (wg : Loc) (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (w : Loc) (r :
    mvcc.WatchRange) (fcs : GoSlice) : mvcc.ownWatcherGroup wg W ∗ mvcc.watcherFixed w r fcs ⊢
    mvcc.ownWatcherGroup wg W ∗ ⌜W !! w = none ∨ W !! w = some r⌝

theorem mvcc.entries_ne {α : Type} (L : List (adt.IvlS × α)) (hnd : (List.map Prod.fst L).Nodup) {i
    k : Nat} {y z : adt.IvlS × α} (hy : L[k]? = some y) (hz : L[i]? = some z) (hki : k ≠ i) : y.fst
    ≠ z.fst

def mvcc.coverUpTo (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (key : GoString) (ivls : List adt.IvlS) : GMap Loc
    Unit :=
  mvcc.membersBy W fun r =>
    decide (r.end? = none) && decide (r.key = key) ||
      decide (Option.map (fun e => (r.key, e)) r.end? ∈ List.map some ivls)

theorem mvcc.upTo_zero (keys : List Loc) (S' : GMap Loc Unit) : mvcc.upTo keys 0 S' = ∅

theorem mvcc.strLt_succ_le {k b : GoString} (h : go.GoStringLt k b) : k ++ [0#8] = b ∨ go.GoStringLt
    (k ++ [0#8]) b

def mvcc.ownWatcherSetOpt (m : GoMap) (S : GMap Loc Unit) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜m = map.nil ∧ S = ∅⌝ ∨ mvcc.ownWatcherSet m S)

theorem mvcc.ownWatcherGroupAt_member (wg : Loc) (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (ws : GoMap) (w :
    Loc) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (fcs : GoSlice) : mvcc.ownWatcherGroupAt wg W ws ∗ mvcc.watcherFixed
    w r fcs ⊢ mvcc.ownWatcherGroupAt wg W ws ∗ ⌜W !! w = none ∨ W !! w = some r⌝

theorem mvcc.membersBy_insert_none (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (p : mvcc.WatchRange → Bool) (w :
    Loc) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (hw : W !! w = none) : mvcc.membersBy (<[w := r]>W) p = if p r = true
    then <[w := ()]>(mvcc.membersBy W p) else mvcc.membersBy W p

def mvcc.watcherFixed (w : Loc) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (fcs : GoSlice) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜w ≠ null⌝ ∗
      ∃ ks es,
        typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watcher go!"key" w) ks
            DFrac.discard ∗
          ownSlice ks r.key DFrac.discard ∗
            typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watcher go!"end" w) es
                DFrac.discard ∗
              (match r.end? with
                | none => ⌜es = slice.nil⌝
                | some e => ⌜es ≠ slice.nil⌝ ∗ ownSlice es e DFrac.discard) ∗
                typedPointsto
                    (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watcher
                      go!"startRev" w)
                    r.startRev DFrac.discard ∗
                  typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watcher go!"id" w) r.id
                      DFrac.discard ∗
                    typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watcher go!"fcs" w)
                      fcs DFrac.discard)

def mvcc.ownKeyMap (km : GoMap) (KM : GMap GoString GoMap) (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (q : Qp :=
    1) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(ownMap km (DFrac.own q) KM ∗
      ⌜∀ (k : GoString), (KM !! k).isSome = true ↔ ∃ w r, W !! w = some r ∧ r.end? = none ∧ r.key = k⌝ ∗
        [∗map] k ↦ m ∈ KM, mvcc.ownWatcherSet m (mvcc.keyMembers W k) q)

theorem mvcc.ownWatcherGroupAt_set (wg : Loc) (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (ws : GoMap) (q : Qp) :
    mvcc.ownWatcherGroupAt wg W ws q ⊢ mvcc.ownWatcherSet ws W.domSet q ∗ (mvcc.ownWatcherSet ws
    W.domSet q -∗ mvcc.ownWatcherGroupAt wg W ws q)

def mvcc.upTo (keys : List Loc) (n : Nat) (S' : GMap Loc Unit) : GMap Loc Unit :=
  GMap.filter (fun k x => decide (k ∈ List.take n keys)) S'

theorem mvcc.ownKeyMap_insert_range (km : GoMap) (KM : GMap GoString GoMap) (W : GMap Loc
    mvcc.WatchRange) (wa : Loc) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (hw : W !! wa = none) (he : r.end? ≠ none) :
    mvcc.ownKeyMap km KM W ⊢ mvcc.ownKeyMap km KM <[wa := r]>W

theorem mvcc.ownKeyMap_delete_range (km : GoMap) (KM : GMap GoString GoMap) (W : GMap Loc
    mvcc.WatchRange) (wa : Loc) (r : mvcc.WatchRange) (hw : W !! wa = some r) (he : r.end? ≠ none) :
    mvcc.ownKeyMap km KM W ⊢ mvcc.ownKeyMap km KM (GMap.delete wa W)

theorem mvcc.coverUpTo_snoc (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (key : GoString) (ivls : List adt.IvlS)
    (ivl : adt.IvlS) : mvcc.coverUpTo W key (ivls ++ [ivl]) = mvcc.coverUpTo W key ivls ∪
    mvcc.ivlMembers W ivl

structure mvcc.WatcherSt : Type where
  minRev : w64
  victim : Bool
  compacted : Bool
  restore : Bool
  ch : GoChan

theorem mvcc.coverUpTo_nil (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (key : GoString) : mvcc.coverUpTo W key []
    = mvcc.keyMembers W key

theorem mvcc.upTo_succ (keys : List Loc) (S' : GMap Loc Unit) (n : Nat) (key : Loc) (hkey : keys[n]?
    = some key) (hnd : keys.Nodup) (hS : S' !! key = some ()) : mvcc.upTo keys (n + 1) S' = <[key :=
    ()]>(mvcc.upTo keys n S') ∧ mvcc.upTo keys n S' !! key = none

theorem mvcc.ownWatcherGroupAt_intro (wg : Loc) (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (km ws t : Loc) (KM :
    GMap GoString GoMap) (L : List adt.Entry) (hL : mvcc.RangesOk W L) : (typedPointsto wg {
    keyWatchers' := km, ranges' := interface.mkOk
    go_etcd_io.etcd.pkg.v3.adt.intervalTree.ty.PointerType (intoVal t), watchers' := ws } (DFrac.own
    1) ∗ mvcc.ownWatcherSet ws W.domSet ∗ ([∗map] w ↦ r ∈ W, iprop(∃ fcs, mvcc.watcherFixed w r
    fcs)) ∗ mvcc.ownKeyMap km KM W ∗ adt.ownIvt t L 1 ∗ [∗list] z ∈ L, mvcc.rangeSet W z) ⊢
    mvcc.ownWatcherGroupAt wg W ws

theorem mvcc.mem_membersBy (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (p : mvcc.WatchRange → Bool) (w : Loc) :
    (mvcc.membersBy W p !! w).isSome = true ↔ ∃ r, W !! w = some r ∧ p r = true
